title: Short exactness of extension presentation
statement: The canonical extension presentation gives a short exact sequence.

proof.text: Embed G in the injective abelian sheaf I. The existing lifting-torsor theorem (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.Torsor.exists_equiv_lifts, attached to thm-galois-torsor-h1) gives an equivariant natural map T to I whose translation part is the monomorphism G to I. Extend it across the presentation universal property. The composite of the presentation inclusion with this extension is the chosen monomorphism, so the presentation inclusion is monic.

Maps from the constant integer sheaf are determined by their values on one. These values may be checked on the covering sieve where T has sections, using torsor ext_of_nonempty and sheaf separation. The projection sends every torsor generator to one; hence two maps agreeing after the projection agree locally on one and therefore everywhere. Thus the projection is epic.

For a map k from the presentation to an abelian sheaf A annihilating G, its values on torsor generators are invariant under G. Apply the existing invariant-section gluing lemma exists_section_of_invariant to get a global section of A. Integer multiples of its restrictions define a map from the constant integer presheaf; sheafification gives l from the constant integer sheaf. The maps projection followed by l and k agree on G and all torsor generators, so presentation uniqueness makes them equal. The epic projection is consequently a cokernel of the inclusion.
In the abelian category of sheaves, a monomorphism followed by its cokernel is short exact. Apply ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel and the monicity and epicity established above.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 03AJ (lemma-torsors-h1), injective embedding and invariant-section argument using the proved source-library lifting-torsor theorem

theorem extension_presentation_shortExact (S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    {G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max u w + 1}} {T : Torsor G}
    (E : ExtensionPresentation.{u, w} S T) :
    (ShortComplex.mk E.inclusion E.projection E.inclusion_projection).ShortExact
